t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There is no real pattern, but some baskets come from particular gnomes.

vb_textbox.text: I feel there is absolutely no correlation between he +1 and +5, the gnomes and the basket colour. I initially tried going for the left gnome on a +5 and the right gnome on a +1, but some of the time I was getting high scores and some I was getting low scores.
